law.name: F_K = K'UHUL Fold Space
law.learning_coordinate: p_t = (h, phi, T, s, sigma, X_t)
law.lattice_slice: Fold Lattice K = (theta, sigma) is a projection/slice of Fold Space, not the full position.
law.phase_authority: C6 is execution coordinates; S1 is geometric projection only.
law.movement_axes: horizontal = Delta T, vertical = Delta phi, radial = Delta s
law.pipeline: LOCATE -> UNFOLD -> NAVIGATE -> OPERATE -> VERIFY -> FOLD -> XUL
law.boundary: Fold Space != Fold Lattice != Fold Kernel != XCFE Policy != Execution
law.fold_boundary: Fold != Xul; fold/unfold toggles s while Xul remains the commit/collapse phase.
law.proof_boundary: Sek proposes, Ch'en proves, XCFE authorizes, Xul commits.
law.event_transition_boundary: Fold Events record proposed/observed movement; XCFE evaluates p_next = delta_XCFE(p_t,e_t,Pi).

distance_metrics.phase: d_phase = shortest path distance on C6
distance_metrics.fold_field: d_fold(a,b) = alpha * L1(field_a - field_b)/2 + (1-alpha) * mean_abs_dev(wcr_scores); alpha default 0.7; range [0,1]

authority_required.proof_boundary: Sek proposes, Ch'en proves, XCFE authorizes, Xul commits

invariants.FS3: T identifies an active semantic track
invariants.FS5: X_t is mutable runtime state, not semantic topology
invariants.FS6: sigma is optional, but if present sigma in competence_axis
invariants.FS7: horizontal movement changes T while holding phi
invariants.FS8: vertical movement advances phi by one C6 step while holding T
invariants.FS9: radial movement toggles s while holding phi and T
invariants.FS10: C6 is authoritative execution coordinate; S1 angle is projection only
invariants.FS11: Book(h) = N(h) and Unfold(h,tau) is bounded by B_tau[h,e] != 0
invariants.FS12: distance is typed: semantic, phase, track, or behavior; no universal metric is implied
invariants.FS13: navigation order is LOCATE -> UNFOLD -> NAVIGATE -> OPERATE -> VERIFY -> FOLD -> XUL
invariants.FS15: Sek proposes, Ch'en proves, XCFE authorizes, Xul commits
invariants.FS16: FoldField vertex = (node_id, theta, W, C, R); score() = W*C*R; theta from C6 canonical phase_angle()
invariants.FS18: (Fold∘Unfold)(h)≡h identity invariant; violation drops sigma to UNBOUND
invariants.FS19: fold_distance typed: alpha*L1(field)/2 + (1-alpha)*mean_abs_dev(wcr); alpha=0.7 default; range [0,1]
